name: xpmem
description: XPMEM (Linux Cross-Memory Attach) userspace library and header from the Open MPI-compatible openucx/xpmem source, configured with --disable-kernel-module. Installs libxpmem and xpmem.h, providing the xpmem_make API required by Open MPI's --with-xpmem support. The kernel module is neither built nor installed; runtime use requires the host to provide and load a matching xpmem kernel module.
